title.en: Add a file to a story

descriptions.zh:
**请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解 PDS 的收费方式和[价格](~~425220~~)**。

使用此功能须开通增值服务图片处理功能。

用户在创建故事后，可以手动给指定故事添加想要的文件。
descriptions.en:
**Before you call this API, make sure that you understand the billing methods and [pricing](~~425220~~) of PDS**.

To use this feature, you must enable the image processing feature.

After you create a story, you can manually add files to it.
